newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to offer states breathing space on debt.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to offer states breathing space on debt.

text.p: Brazilian states who sign up for a debt refinancing deal with the central government may be granted up to three months' grace from the cost of servicing their debts with federal banks, an official said.
Wednesday's meeting of the National Monetary Council approved a proposal that would give the state's a "breathing space" in their debt-servicing expenditure, a spokesman at the Finance Ministry said.

So far, Rio Grande do Sul is the only state to have joined the program whereby expensive short-term debt is replaced by cheaper, longer-term federal paper on condition the state retires 20 percent of its debt stockpile.
Minas Gerais state was due to join the the central government's program later on Thursday.
The spokesman said states included in the program would be granted a maximum of three months' grace from interest payments on their debt with federal banks on a case-by-case basis.
